## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor

## Screenshots (UI changes)

Add before/after screenshots or a short recording when the UI changes.

## Testing

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q`
- [ ] `python -m compileall -q core`
- [ ] `cd LeadGenUI && npm run build`
- [ ] Docker Compose smoke test (when relevant)
- [ ] Screenshots regenerated (when the UI changes)

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to one concern.
- [ ] Documentation is updated.
- [ ] No `.env`, Chrome profile, cookies, SMTP credentials or real lead data
      are included.
- [ ] Third-party assets include a license and notice.
- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
